results.sql_query:
WITH gender_concepts AS (
  SELECT concept_id, concept_name AS gender_name
  FROM omop.concept
  WHERE domain_id = 'Gender' AND standard_concept = 'S'
),
ethnicity_concepts AS (
  SELECT concept_id, concept_name AS ethnicity_name
  FROM omop.concept
  WHERE domain_id = 'Ethnicity' AND standard_concept = 'S'
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(gc.gender_name, 'Unknown') AS gender,
  COALESCE(ec.ethnicity_name, 'Unknown') AS ethnicity,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.person p
LEFT JOIN gender_concepts gc ON p.gender_concept_id = gc.concept_id
LEFT JOIN ethnicity_concepts ec ON p.ethnicity_concept_id = ec.concept_id
GROUP BY gc.gender_name, ec.ethnicity_name;

results.sql_query:
WITH drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '313782' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361615' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
drug1_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_concepts)
),
drug2_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_concepts)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM drug1_exposures d1
JOIN drug2_exposures d2 ON d1.person_id = d2.person_id
WHERE CAST(
  EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(GREATEST(d1.start_date, d2.start_date) AS TIMESTAMP) -
  CAST(LEAST(d1.start_date, d2.start_date) AS TIMESTAMP)
) / 86400 AS BIGINT
) <= 30;

 WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '7804' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug1_mapped AS (
 SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
 FROM drug1_source ds
 JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
 WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_hierarchy AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
 FROM drug1_mapped dm
 JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
 JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
drug2_source AS (

 WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '4850' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (

)

  AND de4.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug4_concepts)
  AND CAST(
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (
      CAST(GREATEST(de1.drug_exposure_start_date, de2.drug_exposure_start_date, de3.drug_exposure_start_date, de4.drug_exposure_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP) -
      CAST(LEAST(de1.drug_exposure_start_date, de2.drug_exposure_start_date, de3.drug_exposure_start_date, de4.drug_exposure_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP)
    )) / 86400 AS BIGINT
  ) <= 30;

WITH drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '312935' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1740467' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361615' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug3_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug4_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1115005' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug4_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug4_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug4_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug4_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.drug_exposure de1
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de2 ON de1.person_id = de2.person_id
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de3 ON de1.person_id = de3.person_id
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de4 ON de1.person_id = de4.person_id
WHERE de1.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_hierarchy)
  AND de2.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_hierarchy)
  AND de3.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug3_hierarchy)
  AND de4.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug4_hierarchy)
  AND CAST(
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (
      CAST(GREATEST(de1.drug_exposure_start_date, de2.drug_exposure_start_date, de3.drug_exposure_start_date, de4.drug_exposure_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP) -
      CAST(LEAST(de1.drug_exposure_start_date, de2.drug_exposure_start_date, de3.drug_exposure_start_date, de4.drug_exposure_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP)
    )) / 86400 AS BIGINT
  ) <= 30;

WITH drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '312935' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361615' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1483571' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug3_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug4_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1658259' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug4_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug4_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug4_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug4_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.drug_exposure de1
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de2 ON de1.person_id = de2.person_id
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de3 ON de1.person_id = de3.person_id
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de4 ON de1.person_id = de4.person_id
WHERE de1.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_concepts)
  AND de2.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_concepts)
  AND de3.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug3_concepts)
  AND de4.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug4_concepts)
  AND CAST(
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (
      CAST(GREATEST(de1.drug_exposure_start_date, de2.drug_exposure_start_date, de3.drug_exposure_start_date, de4.drug_exposure_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP) -
      CAST(LEAST(de1.drug_exposure_start_date, de2.drug_exposure_start_date, de3.drug_exposure_start_date, de4.drug_exposure_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP)
    )) / 86400 AS BIGINT
  ) <= 30;

),
drug1_concepts AS (

  FROM drug1_mapped dm

),

drug2_source AS (

),
drug2_mapped AS (

),

  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361615' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug3_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug4_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1115005' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug4_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug4_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug4_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug4_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

exposures AS (
  SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date, 'd1' AS drug
  FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_concepts)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date, 'd2'
  FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_concepts)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date, 'd3'
  FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug3_concepts)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date, 'd4'
  FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug4_concepts)
),
patient_counts AS (
  SELECT person_id,
         MAX(start_date) AS max_date,
         MIN(start_date) AS min_date,
         COUNT(DISTINCT drug) AS drug_cnt
  FROM exposures
  GROUP BY person_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT drug) = 4
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM patient_counts
WHERE CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(max_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(min_date AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) <= 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.drug_exposure de1
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de2 ON de1.person_id = de2.person_id

        CAST(de2.drug_exposure_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
        CAST(de3.drug_exposure_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
        CAST(de4.drug_exposure_start_date AS TIMESTAMP)
      ) -
      LEAST(
        CAST(de1.drug_exposure_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
        CAST(de2.drug_exposure_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
        CAST(de3.drug_exposure_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
        CAST(de4.drug_exposure_start_date AS TIMESTAMP)

    )) / 86400 AS BIGINT
  ) <= 30;

WITH drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1740467' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1049621' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361615' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug3_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug4_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1483571' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug4_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug4_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug4_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug4_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.drug_exposure d1
JOIN omop.drug_exposure d2 ON d1.person_id = d2.person_id
JOIN omop.drug_exposure d3 ON d1.person_id = d3.person_id
JOIN omop.drug_exposure d4 ON d1.person_id = d4.person_id
WHERE d1.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_concepts)
  AND d2.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_concepts)
  AND d3.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug3_concepts)
  AND d4.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug4_concepts)
  AND CAST(
        EXTRACT(epoch FROM (
          CAST(GREATEST(d1.drug_exposure_start_date, d2.drug_exposure_start_date, d3.drug_exposure_start_date, d4.drug_exposure_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP) -
          CAST(LEAST(d1.drug_exposure_start_date, d2.drug_exposure_start_date, d3.drug_exposure_start_date, d4.drug_exposure_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP)
        )) / 86400 AS BIGINT
      ) <= 30;

  ),

    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
  ),
  drug2_source AS (

  ),
  drug2_mapped AS (

    WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
  ),

    SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM drug2_mapped dm
    JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
  ),
  drug3_source AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
    WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361615' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
  ),
  drug3_mapped AS (
    SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
    FROM drug3_source ds
    JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
    WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
  ),
  drug3_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM drug3_mapped dm
    JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
  ),
  drug4_source AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
    WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1658259' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
  ),
  drug4_mapped AS (
    SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
    FROM drug4_source ds
    JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
    WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
  ),
  drug4_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM drug4_mapped dm
    JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
  )

FROM omop.drug_exposure de1
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de2 ON de1.person_id = de2.person_id

```sql
          ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1 
         AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
         AND cr.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug4_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM drug4_mapped dm
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca 
          ON dm.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

/* Sennosides, USP 8.6 MG Oral Tablet */
drug5_source AS (
    SELECT concept_id 
    FROM omop.concept 
    WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' 
      AND concept_code = 'sennosides_8.6mg_oral_tablet'
),
drug5_mapped AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(cr.concept_id_2, ds.concept_id) AS concept_id
    FROM drug5_source ds
    LEFT JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr 
          ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1 
         AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
         AND cr.invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug5_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM drug5_mapped dm
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca 
          ON dm.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

/* 2. Pull each drug exposure (start date) for persons who have the drug */
de1 AS (
    SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure
    WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_hierarchy)
),
de2 AS (
    SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure
    WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_hierarchy)
),
de3 AS (
    SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure
    WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug3_hierarchy)
),
de4 AS (
    SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure
    WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug4_hierarchy)
),
de5 AS (
    SELECT person_id, drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure
    WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug5_hierarchy)
)

/* 3. Keep only persons who have *all* five exposures and whose dates lie within 30 days */
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM de1 d1
JOIN de2 d2 ON d1.person_id = d2.person_id
JOIN de3 d3 ON d1.person_id = d3.person_id
JOIN de4 d4 ON d1.person_id = d4.person_id
JOIN de5 d5 ON d1.person_id = d5.person_id
WHERE CAST(
        EXTRACT(epoch FROM 
            CAST(GREATEST(d1.start_date, d2.start_date, d3.start_date, d4.start_date, d5.start_date) AS TIMESTAMP) -
            CAST(LEAST(d1.start_date, d2.start_date, d3.start_date, d4.start_date, d5.start_date) AS TIMESTAMP)
        ) / 86400 AS BIGINT
      ) <= 30;
```

**Explanation**

1. **Hierarchy expansion** – For each of the five RxNorm drug codes we create a CTE (`drugX_hierarchy`) that:
   * Finds the source concept (`*_source`),
   * Maps it to its standard RxNorm concept (`*_mapped`),
   * Retrieves every descendant concept (`*_hierarchy`) via `concept_ancestor`.  
   This guarantees that all brand, formulation, or strength variants are captured.

2. **Drug exposures** – Five CTEs (`de1` … `de5`) pull every exposure of the corresponding drug for every person.

3. **Temporal co‑occurrence** – The five exposure tables are inner‑joined on `person_id`.  
   The `GREATEST`/`LEAST` functions compute the span between the earliest and latest exposure start dates for a given person.  
   The required date‑difference formula (using `EXTRACT(epoch)`) enforces that this span is **≤ 30 days**.

4. **Result** – The final `COUNT(DISTINCT ...)` returns the number of unique patients who received **all five drugs within a 30‑day window**.

WITH drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '312935' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '313782' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1049621' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug3_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug4_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361615' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug4_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug4_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug4_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug4_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) FROM (
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_hierarchy)
  INTERSECT
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_hierarchy)
  INTERSECT
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug3_hierarchy)
  INTERSECT
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug4_hierarchy)
) AS intersect_patients;

WITH drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '313782' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1740467' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361615' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug3_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.drug_exposure de1
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de2 ON de1.person_id = de2.person_id
JOIN omop.drug_exposure de3 ON de1.person_id = de3.person_id
WHERE de1.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_concepts)
  AND de2.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_concepts)
  AND de3.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug3_concepts)
  AND CAST(
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (
      CAST(GREATEST(de1.drug_exposure_start_date, de2.drug_exposure_start_date, de3.drug_exposure_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP) -
      CAST(LEAST(de1.drug_exposure_start_date, de2.drug_exposure_start_date, de3.drug_exposure_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP)
    )) / 86400 AS BIGINT
  ) <= 30;

WITH drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept

),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1740467' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1483571' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug3_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id

)

JOIN omop.drug_exposure de2 ON de1.person_id = de2.person_id

      CAST(LEAST(de1.drug_exposure_start_date, de2.drug_exposure_start_date, de3.drug_exposure_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP)
    )) / 86400 AS BIGINT
  ) <= 30;

WITH drug1_source AS (

  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1807639' AND invalid_reason IS NULL

drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1361615' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '1115005' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug3_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id

results.sql_query:
WITH drug1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '9863' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '7804' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

drug3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm' AND concept_code = '161' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
drug3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
drug3_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM drug3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) FROM (
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug1_concepts)
  UNION
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug2_concepts)
  UNION
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM drug3_concepts)
) AS union_patients;

The request is to count the distinct patients who have been exposed to any of the following drugs (union / OR logic):

* **sennosides USP**
* **ondansetron**
* **acetaminophen**
* **sennosides USP** (appears twice – it is counted only once)

The query must:

1. Resolve each drug name to its source concept (using the **concept** table).  
2. Map the source concept to the standard concept (via **concept_relationship** with `relationship_id = 'Maps to'`).  
3. Expand the standard concept to all descendant concepts (via **concept_ancestor**).  
4. Count distinct `person_id` in **drug_exposure** whose `drug_concept_id` belongs to the combined set of drug concepts.

Below is the SQL that follows the required 3‑step hierarchy, uses the schema **omop**, and implements a **union** (OR) query type.

```sql
/* 1️⃣  Resolve each drug name to its source concept */
WITH sennosides_src AS (
    SELECT concept_id
    FROM omop.concept
    WHERE concept_name = 'sennosides USP'
      AND vocabulary_id = 'USP'
      AND domain_id = 'Drug'
      AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),

ondansetron_src AS (
    SELECT concept_id
    FROM omop.concept
    WHERE concept_name = 'ondansetron'
      AND vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
      AND domain_id = 'Drug'
      AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),

acetaminophen_src AS (
    SELECT concept_id
    FROM omop.concept
    WHERE concept_name = 'acetaminophen'
      AND vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
      AND domain_id = 'Drug'
      AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),

/* 2️⃣  Map source concepts to standard concepts */
sennosides_std AS (
    SELECT cr.concept_id_2 AS standard_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_relationship cr
    JOIN sennosides_src ss ON cr.concept_id_1 = ss.concept_id
    WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
      AND cr.invalid_reason IS NULL
),

ondansetron_std AS (
    SELECT cr.concept_id_2 AS standard_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_relationship cr
    JOIN ondansetron_src os ON cr.concept_id_1 = os.concept_id
    WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
      AND cr.invalid_reason IS NULL
),

acetaminophen_std AS (
    SELECT cr.concept_id_2 AS standard_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_relationship cr
    JOIN acetaminophen_src aps ON cr.concept_id_1 = aps.concept_id
    WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
      AND cr.invalid_reason IS NULL
),

/* 3️⃣  Expand to all descendant (hierarchical) concepts */
sennosides_hier AS (
    SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    JOIN sennosides_std ss ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = ss.standard_concept_id
),

ondansetron_hier AS (
    SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    JOIN ondansetron_std os ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = os.standard_concept_id
),

acetaminophen_hier AS (
    SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca
    JOIN acetaminophen_std aps ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = aps.standard_concept_id
),

/* Combine all drug concept IDs (union / OR logic) */
all_drug_concepts AS (
    SELECT concept_id FROM sennosides_hier
    UNION
    SELECT concept_id FROM ondansetron_hier
    UNION
    SELECT concept_id FROM acetaminophen_hier
)

/* Final count of distinct patients */
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM all_drug_concepts);
```

**Explanation of the query**

| Step | What it does |
|------|--------------|
| `sennosides_src`, `ondansetron_src`, `acetaminophen_src` | Finds the *source* concept IDs for the four drug names. |
| `*_std` CTEs | Maps each source concept to its *standard* OMOP concept via `concept_relationship` (`Maps to`). |
| `*_hier` CTEs | Retrieves **all descendant concepts** of each standard drug concept using `concept_ancestor` (covers any formulation, brand, or dose variations). |
| `all_drug_concepts` | Unites the three drug hierarchies (union / OR). Duplicate “sennosides USP” is automatically removed. |
| Final `SELECT` | Counts distinct `person_id` in `drug_exposure` whose `drug_concept_id` belongs to the combined set. |

The result will be a single number, e.g.:

```
Found 1234 patients.
```

If you need the actual count, the above SQL can be executed directly against the OMOP database.

results.response:
Below is a **minimal‑yet‑robust** regular‑expression you can use to pull the **drug name** (the very first column) from every line of the CSV‑style payload you posted.

```regex
(?m)^(?:"([^"]+)"|([^,]+))
```

### How it works  

| Part of the pattern | What it does |
|---------------------|--------------|
| `(?m)`              | Enables **multiline** mode so `^`/`$` match the start/end of each line. |
| `^`                 | Anchors the match at the **beginning of a line** (the drug‑name column). |
| `(?:"([^"]+)"|([^,]+))` | Two alternatives inside a **non‑capturing group**:  |
| ` "([^"]+)" `       | If the field is **quoted** (it contains commas, e.g. `"3 ML Insulin, Aspart, Human …"`), capture everything up‑to the closing quote. |
| `|`                 | **OR** |
| `([^,]+)`           | If the field is **not quoted**, capture everything up‑to the first comma. |

The expression therefore returns **exactly one capture group per line** – either `group 1` (quoted case) or `group 2` (unquoted case).  
You can simply coalesce the two groups to get the drug name.

---

## One‑liner examples in a few popular languages

### Python

```python
import re, json, textwrap

# `payload` is the raw string you posted (the whole CSV block)
payload = """43252441,Bisoprolol 2.5 MG Oral Tablet,OMOP561862,RxNorm Extension,Drug
43258785,"2.5 ML Alprostadil 1.5 MG/ML Injection",OMOP561869,RxNorm Extension,Drug
43270562,2.5 ML Atracurium 10 MG/ML Injection Box of 5,OMOP561864,RxNorm Extension,Drug
43280604,3 ML Haloperidol 50 MG/ML Injection Box of 5,OMOP561911,RxNorm Extension,Drug
...
"""

# Regex from above
pattern = re.compile(r'(?m)^(?:"([^"]+)"|([^,]+))')

drug_names = [m.group(1) or m.group(2) for m in pattern.finditer(payload)]
print(drug_names[:10])      # → first 10 names
```

**Result (first 10 entries)**  

```
['43252441',
 '43258785',
 '43270562',
 '43280604',
 ...]
```

*(In the snippet above the first column of the very first line is actually an OMOP ID, not a drug name – the regex simply extracts the first field whatever it is.)*

If you **only want rows whose first column looks like a drug name** (i.e. contains letters, spaces, “ML”, “MG”, etc.), you can add a quick filter:

```python
drug_names = [name for name in drug_names if re.search(r'[A-Za-z]', name)]
```

### JavaScript (Node / Browser)

```js
const payload = `43252441,Bisoprolol 2.5 MG Oral Tablet,OMOP561862,RxNorm Extension,Drug
43258785,"2.5 ML Alprostadil 1.5 MG/ML Injection",OMOP561869,RxNorm Extension,Drug
43270562,2.5 ML Atracurium 10 MG/ML Injection Box of 5,OMOP561864,RxNorm Extension,Drug
43280604,3 ML Haloperidol 50 MG/ML Injection Box of 5,OMOP561911,RxNorm Extension,Drug
...`;

const regex = /^(?:"([^"]+)"|([^,]+))/gm;
let match, names = [];

while ((match = regex.exec(payload)) !== null) {
  names.push(match[1] ?? match[2]);   // use the defined capture
}
console.log(names.slice(0, 10));
```

### Bash (GNU grep / sed)

```bash
# Grab the first column, handling optional double‑quotes
grep -Po '^(?:"[^"]+"|[^,]+)' file.txt |
sed -E 's/^"([^"]+)"$/\1/'
```

*`grep -P` enables PCRE (the `?` lazy quantifier) and `-o` prints only the match.*  
`sed` then strips the surrounding quotes for the quoted fields.

---

## Why a *regex* is enough (and when you might want a CSV parser)

* The data is **well‑behaved CSV** – each line has exactly one *first* column, and any commas inside that column are properly quoted.
* A single‑pass regex can pull the column **without loading the whole file into a CSV library**, which is handy for quick “one‑liner” extracts or log‑parsing pipelines.

**But** if you later need to:

* handle escaped quotes (`""` inside a quoted field),
* read the file line‑by‑line while also extracting other columns,
* or guarantee strict RFC‑4180 compliance,

…then using a **CSV parser** (Python’s `csv`, JavaScript’s `PapaParse`, etc.) is safer and often just as concise.

---

### TL;DR – one‑liner you can copy‑paste

```regex
(?m)^(?:"([^"]+)"|([^,]+))
```

*Apply it in your favourite language, take `group 1` if present otherwise `group 2`, and you have the drug name (or the very first field) from every line.*

WITH cond1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '14669001' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond1_source cs
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cs.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond1_mapped cm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON cm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
cond2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '49436004' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond2_source cs
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cs.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond2_mapped cm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON cm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) FROM (
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond1_concepts)
  UNION
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond2_concepts)
) AS union_patients;

WITH condition1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '14669001' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
condition1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM condition1_source cs
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cs.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co1
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co2 ON co1.person_id = co2.person_id
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co3 ON co1.person_id = co3.person_id
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co4 ON co1.person_id = co4.person_id
WHERE co1.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM condition1_hierarchy)
  AND co2.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM condition2_hierarchy)
  AND co3.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM condition3_hierarchy)
  AND co4.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM condition4_hierarchy)
  AND CAST(
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (
      GREATEST(CAST(co1.condition_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
               CAST(co2.condition_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
               CAST(co3.condition_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
               CAST(co4.condition_start_date AS TIMESTAMP))
      - LEAST(CAST(co1.condition_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
               CAST(co2.condition_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
               CAST(co3.condition_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
               CAST(co4.condition_start_date AS TIMESTAMP))
    )) / 86400 AS BIGINT
  ) <= 1000;

WITH cond1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE concept_name = 'Acute kidney injury' AND domain_id = 'Condition' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond1_source cs
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cs.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond1_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond1_mapped cm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON cm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
cond2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE concept_name = 'Type 2 diabetes mellitus' AND domain_id = 'Condition' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond2_source cs
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cs.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond2_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond2_mapped cm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON cm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
cond3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE concept_name = 'Hyperlipidemia' AND domain_id = 'Condition' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond3_source cs
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cs.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond3_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond3_mapped cm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON cm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
cond4_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE concept_name = 'Anemia' AND domain_id = 'Condition' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond4_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond4_source cs
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cs.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond4_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond4_mapped cm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON cm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co1
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co2 ON co1.person_id = co2.person_id
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co3 ON co1.person_id = co3.person_id
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co4 ON co1.person_id = co4.person_id
WHERE co1.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond1_hierarchy)
  AND co2.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond2_hierarchy)
  AND co3.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond3_hierarchy)
  AND co4.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond4_hierarchy)
  AND CAST(
        EXTRACT(epoch FROM (
            CAST(GREATEST(co1.condition_start_date, co2.condition_start_date, co3.condition_start_date, co4.condition_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP) -
            CAST(LEAST(co1.condition_start_date, co2.condition_start_date, co3.condition_start_date, co4.condition_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP)
        )) / 86400 AS BIGINT
      ) <= 1000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co1
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co2 ON co1.person_id = co2.person_id
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co3 ON co1.person_id = co3.person_id
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co4 ON co1.person_id = co4.person_id
WHERE co1.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM condition1_hierarchy)
  AND co2.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM condition2_hierarchy)
  AND co3.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM condition3_hierarchy)
  AND co4.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM condition4_hierarchy)
  AND CAST(
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (
      GREATEST(
        CAST(co1.condition_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
        CAST(co2.condition_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
        CAST(co3.condition_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
        CAST(co4.condition_start_date AS TIMESTAMP)
      ) -
      LEAST(
        CAST(co1.condition_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
        CAST(co2.condition_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
        CAST(co3.condition_start_date AS TIMESTAMP),
        CAST(co4.condition_start_date AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    )) / 86400 AS BIGINT
  ) <= 1000;

WITH cond1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '14669001' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond1_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
cond2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '42343007' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond2_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
cond3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '55822004' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond3_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
cond4_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '836439001' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond4_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond4_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond4_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond4_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.condition_occurrence c1
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence c2 ON c1.person_id = c2.person_id
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence c3 ON c1.person_id = c3.person_id
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence c4 ON c1.person_id = c4.person_id
WHERE c1.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond1_hierarchy)
  AND c2.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond2_hierarchy)
  AND c3.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond3_hierarchy)
  AND c4.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond4_hierarchy)
  AND CAST(
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (
      CAST(GREATEST(c1.condition_start_date, c2.condition_start_date, c3.condition_start_date, c4.condition_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP) -
      CAST(LEAST(c1.condition_start_date, c2.condition_start_date, c3.condition_start_date, c4.condition_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP)
    )) / 86400 AS BIGINT
  ) <= 1000;

),

),

),

  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '271737000' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),

  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON cs.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.condition_occurrence c1
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence c2 ON c1.person_id = c2.person_id
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence c3 ON c1.person_id = c3.person_id

      )
    )) / 86400 AS BIGINT

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.condition_occurrence c1
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence c2 ON c1.person_id = c2.person_id
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence c3 ON c1.person_id = c3.person_id
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence c4 ON c1.person_id = c4.person_id
WHERE c1.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond1_hierarchy)
  AND c2.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond2_hierarchy)
  AND c3.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond3_hierarchy)
  AND c4.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond4_hierarchy)
  AND CAST(
        EXTRACT(epoch FROM
          CAST(GREATEST(c1.condition_start_date, c2.condition_start_date, c3.condition_start_date, c4.condition_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP) -
          CAST(LEAST(c1.condition_start_date, c2.condition_start_date, c3.condition_start_date, c4.condition_start_date) AS TIMESTAMP)
        ) / 86400 AS BIGINT
      ) <= 1000;

results.sql_query:
WITH cond1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '44054006' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond1_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
cond2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '55822004' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond2_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
cond3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '266435005' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond3_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co1.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co1
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co2 ON co1.person_id = co2.person_id
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co3 ON co1.person_id = co3.person_id
WHERE co1.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond1_hierarchy)
  AND co2.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond2_hierarchy)
  AND co3.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond3_hierarchy)
  AND CAST(
    EXTRACT(epoch FROM (
      GREATEST(co1.condition_start_date, co2.condition_start_date, co3.condition_start_date)::timestamp -
      LEAST(co1.condition_start_date, co2.condition_start_date, co3.condition_start_date)::timestamp
    )) / 86400 AS BIGINT
  ) <= 300;

results.sql_query:
WITH cond1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '59621000' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond1_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
cond2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '55822004' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond2_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
cond3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '271737000' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond3_hierarchy AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) FROM (
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond1_hierarchy)
  INTERSECT
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond2_hierarchy)
  INTERSECT
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond3_hierarchy)
) AS intersect_patients;

metadata.expected_output: WITH seeds(vocabulary_id, concept_code) AS ( SELECT 'SNOMED'::text, '14669001'::text UNION ALL SELECT 'SNOMED'::text, '55822004'::text UNION ALL SELECT 'SNOMED'::text, '271737000'::text ), seed_concepts AS ( SELECT c.concept_id AS src_id FROM concept c JOIN seeds s ON s.vocabulary_id = c.vocabulary_id AND s.concept_code = c.concept_code WHERE c.invalid_reason IS NULL ), std AS ( SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(cr.concept_id_2, sc.src_id) AS standard_id FROM seed_concepts sc LEFT JOIN concept_relationship cr ON cr.concept_id_1 = sc.src_id AND cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to' AND cr.invalid_reason IS NULL ), descendants AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM std JOIN concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = std.standard_id JOIN concept c ON c.concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id WHERE c.standard_concept = 'S' AND c.domain_id = 'Condition' AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) FROM condition_occurrence co JOIN descendants d ON co.condition_concept_id = d.concept_id;

results.sql_query:
WITH cond1_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '14669001' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond1_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond1_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond1_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond1_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
cond2_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '55822004' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond2_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond2_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond2_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond2_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),
cond3_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '271737000' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
),
cond3_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM cond3_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
cond3_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM cond3_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) FROM (
  SELECT person_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond1_concepts)

  SELECT person_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond2_concepts)

  SELECT person_id FROM omop.condition_occurrence WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cond3_concepts)
) AS union_patients;

WITH anemia_source AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '271737000' AND invalid_reason IS NULL

anemia_mapped AS (
  SELECT concept_id_2 AS concept_id
  FROM anemia_source ds
  JOIN omop.concept_relationship cr ON ds.concept_id = cr.concept_id_1
  WHERE cr.relationship_id = 'Maps to'

  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM anemia_mapped dm
  JOIN omop.concept c ON dm.concept_id = c.concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON c.concept_id = ca.ancestor_concept_id
),

  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept
  WHERE vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' AND concept_code = '38341003' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
